sbh1.1:1.8: yathāpīhai katyo madhyeṣu ja napadeṣu pratyājāto bhavati pūrvavadyāvadyatra gatiḥ satpuruṣāṇāmiyamucyate āryāyatane pratyājātiḥ |
sbh1.1:1.11: aṁgapratyaṁgāvikalo vā yadrūpeṇāṁpratyaṁgāvaikalyena śrotrāvaikalyādikena bhavyaḥ kuśalapakṣasamudāgamāya |
sbh1.1:1.14: yathāpīhaikatyena tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye śraddhā pratilabdhā bhavati |
sbh1.1:1.16: ayamucyate āyatanagataḥ prasādastadāyatanaṁ tathāgatapravedito dharmavinayaḥ sarveṣāṁ laukikalokottarāṇāṁ śukladharmāṇāmutpattaye |
sbh1.1:1.17: yā punaratra śraddhā, tena pūrvagamenādhipatyena sa āyatanagataḥ prasādaḥ |
sbh1.1:1.18: sarvakleśamalakāluṣyāpanayanā aparivṛttakarmāntatā yena paṁcānāmānantaryāṇāṁ karmaṇāṁ, tadyathā mātṛvadhāt pitṛvadhādarhadvadhātsaṁghabhedāttathāgatasyāntike duṣṭacittarucirotpādādanyatamānyatamadānantaryaṁ karma dṛṣṭa eva dharme na kṛtaṁ bhavati nādhyācaritamiyamucyate |
sbh1.1:1.21: dṛṣṭa eva dharme parivartyābhavyo bhavati parinirvāṇāyāryamārgasyotpattaye tasmādetāni parivṛttakarmāntatetyucyate |
sbh1.1:1.22: svayamevānena sa ātmabhāva ebhiḥ pañcabhiraṅgaiḥ sampādito bhavati |
sbh1.1:1.25: tadyathā buddhānāmutpādaḥ, saddharmadeśanādeśitānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ avasthānamavasthitānāṁ cānupravarttanaṁ |
sbh1.1:1.28: yathāpīhaikatyaḥ sarvasarvasatve ttve ṣu kalyāṇaṁ hitādhyāśayamutpādya prabhūtairduṣkarasahasrairmahatā ca puṇyajñānasambhāreṇa ātmabhāvapratilambhe bodhimaṇḍe niṣadya, pañcanivaraṇāni prahāya, caturṣu smṛtyupasthāneṣu sūpasthitacittaḥ, saptatriṁśad bodhipakṣyān dharmān bhāvayitvā a nuttarāṁ samyaksaṁbodhimabhisaṁbudhyate |
sbh1.1:1.30: atītānāgatapratyutpanneṣvadhvasu evamevā kleśa ā yā ta evaṁ buddhā bhagavanto loka utpadya tasyaiva ca śrāvakalokānukampāmupādāya catvāryāryasatyānyārabhya duḥkha sadbhirayañca dharmo niryāto, deśitaḥ, praśasto buddhaiśca buddhaśrāvakaiścā yamucyate buddhānāmutpādaḥ |
sbh1.1:1.32: deśite saddharme, pravartite dharmacakre, yāvacca buddho bhagavāṁ vān jīvati, tiṣṭhati ca, parinirvṛte ca buddhe bhagavati, yāvatā kālena pratipattirna hīyate, saddharmaśca nāntardhīyate |
sbh1.1:1.35: yatta evādhigantāra ḥ saddharmasya, saddharmasākṣātkriyāyai bhavyāṁ pratibalatāṁ jānatāṁ viditvā yathādhigatāmevānulomikīmavavādānuśāsanīmanupravarttayantīdamucyate avasthitānāṁ dharmāṇāmanupravarttanaṁ |
sbh1.1:2.2: parata ucyante dā yakadānapatayaḥ te yāni tasyānulomikāni jīvito padhāraṇāni taiḥ pratyanukampate nte yaduta cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārairiyamucyate parataḥ pratyanukampā |
sbh1.1:3.2: yathāpīhaikatyastathāgatasya vā, tathāgataśrāvakasya vā antikāddharmaṁ śrutvā śraddhāṁ pratilabhate |
sbh1.1:3.5: abhyavakāśaṁ pravrajya yanva yannva haṁ sarvaṁ kaḍa la travargaṁ, dhanadhānyahiraṇyaṁ cotsṛjya svākhyāte dharmavinaye samyagevāgārādanāgārikāṁ pravrajeyam |
sbh1.1:3.7: ya evamutpannaśchandaḥ kuśaleṣu dharmeṣvayamucyate kuśalo dharmachandaḥ cchandaḥ |
sbh1.1:4.2: yā tameva kuśalaṁ dharmacchandamadhipatiṁ kṛtvā jñapticaturthena vākkarmaṇā upasampatkuśalairaśī ḥśī lasamādānaṁ vā |
sbh1.1:5.2: sa tathā pravrajitaḥ śīlavān viharati, prātimokṣasamvarasaṁvṛtaḥ |
sbh1.1:5.4: aṇumātreṣvavadye ṣu bhayadarśī, samādāya śikṣate śikṣāpadeṣu |
sbh1.1:7.5: na nimittagrāhī bhavati, nānuvyaṁjanagrāhī yato a dhikaraṇama sya pāpakā, akuśalā dharmāścittamanusraveyusteṣāṁ samvarāya pratipadyate |
sbh1.1:7.6: sa śrotreṇa śabdāṁ bdān , ghrāṇena gandhān, jihvayā rasān, kāyena spraṣṭavyāni |
sbh1.1:7.7: , manasā dharmān vijñāya na nimittagrāhī bhavati nānuvyaṁjanagrāhī yato a dhikaraṇamasya pāpakā akuśalā dharmāścittamanusraveyusteṣāṁ samvarā ya pratipadyate, rakṣati mana indriyaṁ mana indriyeṇa samvaramāpadyate |
sbh1.1:7.11: na darpārthaṁ, na madārthaṁ, na maṇḍanārthaṁ, na vibhūṣaṇārthaṁ, yāvadevāsya kāyasya sthitaye, yāpanāyai, brahmacaryānugrahāya iti |
sbh1.1:7.12: paurāṇāṁ vedanāṁ prahāsyāmi, navāṁ ca notpādayiṣyāmi |
sbh1.1:7.14: balaṁca, sukhaṁ cānavadyatā ca, sparśavihāratā ceyamucyate bhojane mātrajñatā |
sbh1.1:8.3: sa divā caṁkramaniṣadyābhyāmāvaraṇīyebhyo dharmebhyaścittaṁ pariśodhya, tato vihārānnirgamya, bahirvihārasya pādau prakṣālya, dakṣiṇena pārśvena siṁhaśayyāṁ kalpayatyālokasaṁjñī, smṛtaḥ, saṁprajānan, utthānasaṁjñāmeva manasi kurvan sa rātryāḥ paścime yāme laghu laghveva prativibudhya, caṁkramaniṣadyābhyā māvaraṇīyebhyo dharmebhyaścittaṁ pariśodhayatīyamucyate pūrvarātrāpararātraṁ jāgarikānuyuktatā |
sbh1.1:8.5: sa tathā jāgarikānuyuktaḥ ati bhi kramapratikrame saṁprajānadvihārī bhavatyālokitavyavalokite, sāmmiñjitaprasārite, sāṁghāṭīcīvarapātradhāraṇe, aśitapītakhāditasvādite nidrāklamavinodane, gate, sthite, niṣaṇṇe, śayite, jāgṛte, bhāṣite, tūṣṇīmbhāve samprajānadvihārī bhavati |
sbh1.1:9.2: sa ebhirdharmaiḥ parikarmabhūmiṁ śodhayitvā viviktāni śayanāsanānyadhyāvasatyaraṇyāni, vṛkṣamūlāni, śūnyāgārāṇi, parvatakandaragiriguhāpalāla puṁjā bhyavakāśaśmaśānavanaprasthāni prāntāni śayanāsanādīnīdamucyate prāvivekyam |
sbh1.1:10.2: so a raṇyagato vā, vṛkṣamūlagato vā, śūnyāgāragato vā, paṁcabhyo nivaraṇebhyaścittaṁ viśodhayati |
sbh1.1:10.4: sa ebhyo nivaraṇebhyaścittaṁ viśodhya vinivaraṇaṁ samādhikalpatāyāmavasthāpayatīyamucyate nivaraṇa viśuddhiḥ |
sbh1.1:10.6: sa pañcanivaraṇāni prahāya cetasopakleśa cetasa upakleśa karāṇi saṁkleśakarāṇi |
sbh1.1:10.7: viviktaṁ kāmairviviktampāpakairakuśalairdharmaiḥ savitarka savicāraṁ vivekajaṁ prītisukhaṁ prathamaṁ dhyānamupasaṁpadya viharati |
sbh1.1:10.8: savitarkasavicārāṇāṁ vyupaśamādadhyātmasaṁprasādāccetasa ekotībhāvādavitarkamavicāraṁ samādhijaṁ prītisukhaṁ dvitīyaṁ dhyānamupasampadya viharati |
sbh1.1:10.9: sa prītervirāgādupekṣako viharati smṛtaḥ saṁprajāna n sukhaṁ ca kāyena pratisamvedayate yat |
sbh1.1:10.10: tadāryā ācakṣate upekṣakaḥ smṛtimān sukhavihārī tṛtīyaṁ dhyānamupasampadya viharati sa sukhasya ca prahāṇāt pūrvameva saumanasyadaurmanasyayorastagamā rastaṅgamā daduḥkhāsukhamupekṣāsmṛtipariśuddhaṁ caturthaṁ dhyānamupasampadya viharati |
sbh1.1:10.12: so a nayānūpūrvyā uttarottarānviśiṣṭān viśiṣṭatarān viśiṣṭatamān pratyagrānātmasampatpūrvān samādhi saṁniśrayaparyavasānān samudānayati |
sbh1.1:10.13: evaṁ pariśuddhe citte paryavadāte anaṁgaṇe vigatopakleśe ṛjubhūte karmaṇye sthite āniṁjyaprāpte sa ceccatvāryāryasatyānyārabhya teṣāṁ parijñāyai prahāṇāya sākṣātkriyāyai bhāvanāyai parato ghoṣamavavā dānuśāsanīṁ pratilabhate |
sbh1.1:10.14: evamasau bhavyo bhavati pratibalaśca yoganimittasya manaskārasyotpādanāya |
sbh1.1:10.22: tatra yaḥ catuḥsatyadeśanāvavādādhipateyaḥ parato ghoṣaḥ, yaśca yoniśo manaskāraḥ |
sbh1.1:11.12: ihāparinirvāṇadharmasya pudgalasyādita evāla tṛṣṇā sarveṇa sarvaṁ sarvathā ca sarvabuddhairāśrayasanniviṣṭā aprahāṇadharmiṇī bhavatyanutpādyā dūrāgatā pragāḍhasanniviṣṭā idaṁ |
sbh1.1:11.13: idaṁ prathama ma gotrakasthasya pudgalasya liṁgaṁ |
sbh1.1:12.1: punaraparamagotrasthaḥ pudgalaḥ anekaparyāyeṇa saṁsāraguṇān vicitrān prabhūtāṁśca śrutvā nirvāṇaguṇāṁścānekaparyāyeṇa vicitrān |
sbh1.1:12.3: saṁvegamātraṁ notpāditavānatītamadhvānamupādāya notpādayiṣyatyānāgata madhvāna mupādāya notpādayati varta mānamadhvānamupādāya parīttakalpamātrakamavaramātrakaṁ nirvāṇe, tṛṣṇākṣaye, virāge, nirodhe guṇadarśanamuśansa śaṁsa darśanaṁ prasādamātrakamatītānāgatapratyutpannamadhvānamupādāya notpāditavānnotpādayiṣyati notpādayati |
sbh1.1:12.5: punaraparamagotrasthaḥ pudgalaḥ anekaparyā yeṇa .............. gāmīduḥ khā patrāpyeṇa samanvāgato bhavati |
sbh1.1:12.7: na ca kadācittani nni dānaṁ vipratisārī bhavati |
sbh1.1:12.11: do ṣa yukte citre tte gamake duḥkhaṁ vā ārabhya, samudayaṁ vā, nirodhamvā, mārgamvā, saddharme deśyamāne na labhate cetasa āvarjanamātre karmaṇi, muktimātre yadutātītamadhvānamupādāyānāgatamadhvānamupādāya ya duta pratyutpannamadhvānamupādāya |
sbh1.1:12.13: punaraparamagotrasthaḥ pudgalaḥ sa cet kadācit karha rhi cit svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajati |
sbh1.1:12.14: sa rājā bhinirṇīto vā, co cau rābhinirṇīto vā, ṛ ṇā rto vā, ajīvikāmayabhīto vā, mā rabhayabhīto vā, aśramaṇaḥ śramaṇaprati jñaḥ, abrahmacārī brahmacārī ri- pratijñaḥ, atītānāgatapratyutpanneṣvadhvasvagotrasthasya pudgalasyaivameva pravrajyā veditavyā |
sbh1.1:12.16: tadanena paryāyeṇānenābhisandhinā arthato nai ryāṇikato a gotrasthaḥ pudgalaḥ pravrajita iti saṁkhyāṁ gacchati |
sbh1.1:13.1: punaraparamagotrasthaḥ pudgalo yatkiṁcit kuśalaṁ karma karoti |
sbh1.1:13.2: kāyena, vācā, manasā vā tatsarvaṁ bhavābhiprāyo vā, viśiṣṭamāyatipunarbhavamabhiprārthayamāno bhogābhiprāyo vā bhavati |
sbh1.1:13.4: evaṁbhāgīyāni cāsya bahūni liṅgāni samvidyante yaiḥ samanvāgataḥ |
sbh1.1:13.5: aparinirvāṇadharmako a parinirvāṇadharmaka iti saṁkhyāṁ gacchati |
sbh1.1:14.4: gotra eva sthito, nāvatīrṇo na niṣkrāntaḥ avatīrṇo na niṣkrāntaḥ, avatīrṇo niṣkrānto , mṛdvindriyo, madhyendriyaḥ, tīkṣṇendriyaḥ, rāgacarito, dveṣacarito, mohacaritaḥ |
sbh1.1:14.6: apramattaḥ, mithyāpratipannaḥ, amithyāpratipannaḥ, āvṛto a nāvṛtaḥ, dūre, antike |
sbh1.1:14.7: paripakvaścā a paripakvaśca, tatra katamo gotrastha eva pudgalaḥ |
sbh1.1:14.10: na ca punaradyāpi labhate satpuruṣasaṁsevāṁ vāgamya, saddharmaśravaṇaṁ vā, tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye śraddhāṁ ca śīlaṁ ca samādadāti |
sbh1.1:14.12: na tyāgaṁ bṛṁhayati, na dṛṣṭimṛjūka roti |
sbh1.1:15.1: a sya viparyayeṇa śuklapakṣeṇa gotrasthaścāvatīrṇaśca veditavyaḥ |
sbh1.1:15.2: ayantu viśeṣo no tu lābhī bhavatyāryamārgasya |
sbh1.1:18.2: yasya nātyarthaṁ jñeye vastunyālamba ne atyarthaṁ dhandhavāhīnīndriyāṇi bhavanti |
sbh1.1:18.4: śrutamayena vā, cintāmayena vā, bhāvanāmayena vā manasikāreṇa saṁprayuktāni |
sbh1.1:18.7: na samarthāni, na pratibalāni dharmasya vā prativedhāyārthasya vāśuca prativedhāya |
sbh1.1:19.2: yasya nātyarthaṁ jñeye vastunyālambane dhandhavāhīnīndriyāṇi sarvaṁ pūrvavadvistareṇa vaktavyamayamucyate madhyendriyaḥ pudgalaḥ |
sbh1.1:20.2: yasya pudgalasya jñeye vastunyālambane a dhandhavāhīnīndriyāṇi bhavanti |
sbh1.1:20.4: śrutamayena vā, cintāmayena vā, bhāvanāmayena vā manasikāreṇa saṁprayuktāni |
sbh1.1:20.5: yaduta śraddhā, vīryaṁ, smṛtiḥ, samādhiḥ, prajñā vā |
sbh1.1:20.6: śaktāni bhavanti dharmasya prativedhāya, arthasya vā āśu ca prativedhāya |
sbh1.1:20.10: yo raṁjanīye ālambane tīvrarāgaśca bhavatyāyatarāgaśca, ayamucyate rāgacaritaḥ pudgalaḥ |
sbh1.1:21.2: yaḥ pra tighasthānīye ālambane tīvradveṣaśca bhavatyāyatadveṣaścāyamucyate dveṣacaritaḥ pudgalaḥ |
sbh1.1:22.2: yo jñeye vastuni tīvramohaśca bhavatyāyatamohaścāyamucyate mohacaritaḥ pudgalaḥ |
sbh1.1:23.2: akṣaṇo papannāḥ pramattāmithyāpratipannānāvṛtā pannā anāvṛtā veditavyā ḥ |
sbh1.1:24.5: anekairjātiśatairanekairjātiśatasahasraiḥ anekajātiśatasahasraiḥ tataḥ paścād bhavyo bhavatyāśupratyayalābhāya |
sbh1.1:24.8: prayogadūratayā pu dgalo gotra eva kevale sthito bhavati |
sbh1.1:24.12: sa nirvāṇāyānārabdhaprayogadūratayā dūratvāt prayoga kāladūratayā ayamucyate dūre pudgalaḥ |
